ownerDecision: docs/decisions/0001-owner-policy.md (The Shuttle becomes an Activity, D10; Shuttle Activity sounds chosen)
policy: Audio assets only: CC0 1.0 and CC BY 3.0/4.0. NC, ND, SA and unclear licences are excluded. Each bundled file is pinned with its SHA-256; CC BY sounds are credited on the Credits screen and in legal/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES, with any changes stated.
selection: The owner chose one option per cue in a private picker page on 21 October 2026. Licences were read from each sound's own page that day.
status: Originals verified (see each file). Converted to Ogg Opus with MP3 fallbacks by scripts/build-shuttle-sounds.mjs; outputs and their hashes are listed per cue. Owner review is recorded under "review".

review.result: Approved: all 24 sounds, with no requested changes.
review.method: Private audition page playing the committed outputs of build 618ef40 in both formats, with loops played between their markers and a seam check.
review.approvedOutputs: The output hashes listed per cue at 618ef40.

encoding.tool: FFmpeg LGPL-3.0-or-later build (legal/DEPENDENCIES.json buildTimeAudioEncoder; review in legal/ffmpeg-build-time-encoder.json), build time only on the development machine
encoding.fallback: MP3, served only to clients that cannot play Ogg Opus (Safari and iOS before 18.4)
encoding.status: Decided and the pinned build verified on 21 October 2026; no sound converted yet. Each converted file will be pinned with its SHA-256 next to its source.
